definitions.gloss: pilgrimage, esp. to the 88 temples of Shikoku; pilgrim
definitions.explanation: A Buddhist pilgrimage around sacred sites, above all the circuit of eighty-eight temples on the island of Shikoku associated with the monk Kūkai ({弘法大師|こうぼうだいし}). The word also names the pilgrim, usually as お{遍路|へんろ}さん.

examples.japanese: お{遍路|へんろ}さん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{定年後|ていねんご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{遍路|へんろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: My father set out on the pilgrimage after he retired.

examples.japanese: {白装束|しろしょうぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{遍路|へんろ}さん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{杖|つえ}→杖：12862_tsue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ついて⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧いく。
examples.english: A pilgrim dressed in white walks up the mountain path with a staff.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{遍路|へんろ}さん: a pilgrim (friendly, everyday form)
- ⟦{四国|しこく}→四国：21447_shikoku⟧{遍路|へんろ}: the Shikoku pilgrimage
- ⟦{歩|ある}き→歩く：00538_aruku⟧{遍路|へんろ}: making the pilgrimage on foot
- {遍路|へんろ}⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧: the pilgrimage route
- {遍路|へんろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to set out on the pilgrimage

CULTURAL NOTE:
The full circuit on foot is more than 1,000 kilometers and usually takes forty to sixty days. Pilgrims wear white and carry a wooden staff, and local people traditionally offer them food, drink, or a place to rest, a custom called お⟦{接待|せったい}→接待：12903_settai⟧. Many people do the route in sections, by bus, or by car.
